summary: ORIX Corporation filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign issuer current report) disclosing monthly status of its ongoing share repurchase program. Under the May 11, 2026 board resolution authorizing up to 100,000,000 shares (~9.1% of outstanding excluding treasury) for up to JPY 250 billion through March 31, 2027, the company bought 6,291,100 common shares for JPY 36,504,385,500 between October 1 and October 31, 2026 via market purchases under a discretionary dealing contract. Cumulative repurchases reached 28,364,900 shares for JPY 175,483,966,900 as of October 31, leaving roughly 70 billion yen of remaining buyback capacity; watch pace of execution and any incremental authorization.
